banner.title: The deity seam close - the Legends & Lore 1984 parity voice adjudicated in full, the seam leaves the queue with NO divergence round
banner.provenance: The seam close (the R1025 registry close leaves the deity seam as the one standing queue item, the arc plan's at-go check now run): the L&L parity inventory swept the pin headers in full - 130 parity notes across the mythos grids (cqc through cqc8, nrs, smr, nhg, nhw, tpl, pln, dga, deities, elysiumbeasts, dpy, dpz) and every one falls into an adjudicated class - pinned by print over the L&L read, the print garbles restored from the L&L voice, the eyeball flags deliberate pin-internal, the tesseract-geometry cells verified, ZERO open divergences; the collation voice throughout was the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows, so NO archive.org derivative tesseract pass is needed - the primary ink (the ddg.pdf second printing, the 310 extract/ddg voices on disk) plus the chart rows carried the whole arc; the at-most-one divergence round is NOT needed and L&L stands as a parity voice, not a second book. The DDG gap report holds 24 boxes closed, zero open; the 338 DDG defs ride canonical full-field since R1025 - the registry 1338 of 1338. THE DEITY SEAM CLOSES.
